title: Weight
description: One line, you don't have to carry all of it at once, set huge in a variable grotesk while a slow wave of weight and width moves through the letters like breath, over a soft drone whose filter opens as the wave passes. Move closer and the wave bends toward you; press and hold and every letter goes heavy, let go and it exhales.
intent: A breathing line whose measure never moves: every letter's weight comes from a travelling wave, and each frame a solver finds the width axis that keeps every line exactly at its resting measure, so weight flows through the letters without the line ever reflowing.
